They control the payment processing, charge high fees, and hold your funds hostage with account suspensions and freezes. In contrast, COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack provides a permanent, sovereign commerce infrastructure that gives creators full ownership and control over their digital commerce stacks. With Edge Commerce Stack, creators can deploy a complete, custom commerce solution in 48 hours, load five products, configure SPF, DKIM, and DMARC for email deliverability, and test the entire stack end-to-end before handoff. This means creators can focus on what matters most – creating and selling their digital art – without worrying about platform restrictions or account suspensions.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Gumroad's payout delays, Payhip's withdrawal restrictions, and Lemon Squeezy's geographic unavailability all stem from the same root cause: these platforms operate within the traditional financial system. They process payments through Stripe or PayPal on the backend, which means they inherit every restriction those processors impose. When Stripe does not support your country, Gumroad cannot pay you out — regardless of what the platform's feature list implies. Paddle operates as a merchant of record, which creates additional compliance requirements that make it functionally unavailable in most of Africa, South Asia, and Latin America. These are not platform-level problems. They are financial system problems that only infrastructure built outside that system can solve.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

PayPal, Stripe, Gumroad, and Lemon Squeezy may offer fast payment processing, but they come with high fees, complex pricing models, and hidden charges that can eat into creators' profits. In contrast, COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack offers fast payment processing with NOWPayments, a low-cost payment gateway that charges only 0.5% per transaction, with no hidden fees or complex pricing models.
